This does not make the original sentence correct or imply another dimension passes.\",\"fail\":\"An evidenced error in this dimension of the visible assessment is established. For a grammar lesson, judge the requested criterion, including any required form or agreement.\",\"boundary\":\"Evaluate the visible target-use claim on its linguistic evidence. A fragment can supply clear lexical evidence while leaving the intended message unknown. Use uncertain when essential evidence for the target claim is unresolved. Missing or wrong sense and derivation into the wrong part of speech can fail the target claim. Grade repair and handling of missing context on their own axes. The caller checks the app message gate separately in policyCompliance.\"},\"grammar\":{\"question\":\"Is the visible grammar judgment about the original supported by English form and the operational label?\",\"rule\":\"Judge the original form and whether the shown label is justified. When an original defect is evident, judging needs_work can pass even if the specific repair depends on time, meaning or assignment form. Do not change the grammar grade merely because a changed replacement makes an unsupported choice or misses a requested clause type.\",\"boundary\":\"Use uncertain for unresolved evidence about the original form itself. An explicit false approval of a visible form error remains a grammar failure even when the ideal rewrite is unknown. The meaning dimension still assesses the requested grammar lesson criterion when applicable. A Korean/English meaning difference is not by itself a grammar error in the original English. Grammar natural can correctly coexist with a changed complete correction under explicit word intended_korean.\"},\"correction\":{\"question\":\"Does the shown complete English responsibly express the applicable intended content?\",\"rule\":\"Only when domain is word AND requestInput.contextRole is intended_korean, use the supplied Korean contextNote as intended meaning. Correction examples are non-exhaustive.\",\"boundary\":\"Keep participants, semantic roles, negation, quantity, time and speech act supported by the applicable intent. Korean can resolve an English fragment without inventing content. Details in the English consistent with a concise Korean summary need not be deleted. Do not invent a missing agent, event or relationship. If essential meaning is still missing, ask the specific question and withhold the completion. Fiction or unusual physical events are not grammar errors. Distinguish a valid alternative from an unsupported semantic choice.\"},\"explanation\":{\"question\":\"Are the actual learner-visible explanation claims and their material implications supported?\",\"rule\":\"Assess the complete visible explanation, including factual rules, edit comparisons and confidence. A material false claim fails this dimension even if another statement is true or the repair is good. An unresolved material claim is uncertain when no false claim is established. A bad grammar label or unnecessary repair alone does not falsify a separate true explanatory claim. A missing required caveat can make an asserted generalization unsupported; do not reward confidence or verbosity.\",\"boundary\":\"Only evaluate claims expressed or materially implied by the explanation. Evaluate structured grammar labels in grammar and the offered repair in correction; do not invent an explanatory assertion by copying those fields into the prose. A statement that an edit preserves a specified action, participants or imperative form need not claim that the original needed correction or that politeness, register and every pragmatic effect are identical. If the prose claims the edit was grammatically necessary, judge that actual claim. Keep overall harmful feedback held even when a narrow factual explanation passes. For explicit Korean intent, do not call a meaning correction an original grammar error. Grade only the explanation actually visible to the learner, not raw hidden model reasons. A concise edit comparison need not teach a general grammar rule.\"},\"abstention\":{\"question\":\"Does the product preserve necessary uncertainty while making independently supported judgments?\",\"rule\":\"This dimension measures handling of missing information, including unnecessary refusal. First declare learnerContext sufficient/missing/unavailable and abstentionNeed required/not_required/unavailable. Missing information means needed to choose a responsible interpretation/repair, not missing proper names for complete pronouns. With sufficient context, a false grammar approval or bad meaning-changing repair is penalized in grammar/correction/explanation/critical flags; it does NOT by itself fail abstention. If no context-dependent choice or unnecessary refusal is made, abstention passes. Unnecessary refusal or an irrelevant context question can fail even when abstentionNeed is not_required.\",\"boundary\":\"With missing essential time/number/message/register, preserve that uncertainty and ask a specific question before choosing an unsafe repair. Known form errors may still be identified. With no visible feedback, all five dimensions and the context/applicability metadata are unavailable; absence is not responsible abstention. Evaluate the product decision shown. A concrete false original-grammar assertion remains evaluable without inventing an alternative rewrite; penalize its false approval on the applicable grammar, explanation and critical axes. If the feedback actually chooses a repair that needs missing context, or fails to preserve material uncertainty, apply the required abstention rule. First inspect both the Korean intent and English. A Korean statement may supply missing agent, event, time or number; its mere presence is not proof of sufficiency. Refusing a supported completion can fail independently. For a grammar lesson, judge the requested criterion, including any required form or agreement.\",\"boundary\":\"Evaluate the visible target-use claim on its linguistic evidence. A fragment can supply clear lexical evidence while leaving the intended message unknown. Use uncertain when essential evidence for the target claim is unresolved. Do not change the grammar grade merely because a changed replacement makes an unsupported choice or misses a requested clause type.\",\"boundary\":\"Use uncertain for unresolved evidence about the original form itself.
